findings.summary: #2371's early exit blinds the TDD evidence gate: touchesSource matches only paths containing src/, and branchFloor() fails open when git diff fails
findings.convergence: found independently by all three agents (regression, data-integrity, edge-cases)
findings.repro: On a generated Go library change root-level math.go, commit 'fix(#42): alter Add' with no #42 evidence — the gate prints 'no src/ change, vacuous pass' and exits 0

findings.summary: host-probe v8 ignore suppresses a loop that runs in normal developer use; its accompanying test only regex-matches the ignore marker, so it stays green if the loop is wrong
findings.repro: Mock homedir() to a temp home containing .claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/session.jsonl and make the selection return the wrong file — coverage stays green

findings.summary: chainIds substring authorization is fail-open: readUnifiedState does not validate chainIds is an array, and .includes() on a string matches substrings
findings.repro: { taskId: '#503', chainIds: '#5040' } authorizes --task #504 because '#5040'.includes('#504') is true

findings.summary: the shallow-history test stubs resolveEvidenceCommit(), so removing the isShallowRepository() branch leaves it green — a vacuous oracle for #2372
coverage tolerance parity claim is false: check-coverage-ratchet now uses 0.4pp while debt-report.mjs still states it mirrors this gate's exact TOLERANCE=0.5pp and still uses 0.5
